questions.q: On 2026-11-14 (UTC), what was the highest hour of demand in ERCOT and in CAISO, and ERCOT's peak was how many times CAISO's?
questions.answer: 2026-11-14: ERCOT 53,695 MW, CAISO 26,746 MW; ERCOT's peak was 2.01 times CAISO's.
steps: Open eia930_all_demand and keep the rows of variable demand_mw for eia930:ERCO and eia930:CISO from 2026-11-14T00:00:00Z to 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z: 24 hours each.
Take the largest of each grid's 24 values: ERCOT 53,695 MW, CAISO 26,746 MW.
Divide the first by the second: 53,695 MW / 26,746 MW = 2.01 times.

questions.q: A well produces 1,000 barrels of oil in 2026-10, valued at that month's WTI Cushing mean. What state production tax does it owe in Texas, in Louisiana (a well completed before July 2025, no transport deducted) and in New Mexico (no royalty, trucking or district ad valorem)?
questions.answer: At 102.07 USD/bbl: Texas 4,695.05 USD, Louisiana 12,758.30 USD, New Mexico 7,287.54 USD; Louisiana's is 2.72 times Texas's.
questions.line: 1,000 bbl x 102.07 USD/bbl x each state's rate: Texas 4,695.05 USD, Louisiana 12,758.30 USD, New Mexico 7,287.54 USD; 12,758.30 USD / 4,695.05 USD = 2.72 times
steps: The mean of 2026-10's daily WTI Cushing spot prices: 102.07 USD/bbl.
Texas: 4.6 percent of value, or 4.6 cents a barrel if more: 4,695.05 USD.
Louisiana: 12.5 percent of value: 12,758.30 USD.

New Mexico: severance 3.75, emergency school 3.15, conservation 0.24 percent of value, the rates the rules file states for 2026-04-01 to 2026-08-31 (TRD table) (the newest it holds; 2026-10 is later): 7,287.54 USD.
Louisiana over Texas: 2.72 times.

questions.q: The home battery game's battery charges once from empty at ERCOT's cheapest average hour of 2026-09 (the latest complete month) and empties at its dearest. What does that one cycle earn, and what would the game's fictional fleet of 10,000 homes earn?
questions.answer: One cycle earns 0.62 USD; the fleet 6,159.21 USD.
questions.line: (12.81 kWh x 73.13 USD/MWh - 14.23 kWh x 22.53 USD/MWh) / 1,000 = 0.62 USD; times the fleet's 10,000 homes = 6,159.21 USD
steps: The cheapest hour of the month's profile is 09:00, 22.53 USD/MWh; the dearest 20:00, 73.13 USD/MWh.
To store 13.5 kWh at 90 percent round trip (the square root of 0.9 each way) it buys 14.23 kWh and delivers 12.81 kWh.
Cash: (12.81 kWh x 73.13 USD/MWh - 14.23 kWh x 22.53 USD/MWh) / 1,000 = 0.62 USD.

questions.q: A default merchant battery at ERCOT's hub average, 100 MW / 400 MWh, financed with 60 percent debt at 8 percent over its 20-year life at Lazard's midpoint cost, owes 6,783,357 USD of debt service a year. In how many of the months held, 2018-07 to 2026-09, could its cash flow at best cover that month's share?
questions.answer: At best, in 26 of 99 months; it fell short in 73 months even with perfect foresight. A real battery, which cannot see the day's prices in advance, earns less and covers fewer.
steps: Each month: the battery's arbitrage revenue (one cycle a day with perfect foresight, an upper bound) less fixed O&M, over one twelfth of the annual debt service: the debt service coverage ratio.
Months held: 99 months; months below 1.0x: 73 months.
Months covered, at best: 99 months - 73 months = 26.
At best, because the revenue is an upper bound, as the seller's tab notes: the battery knows each day's prices in advance; a real one captures a fraction of this.
